description_en: Checks the permissions of data tables in batches
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise check-batch-table-access-permission --table-name-list test_name --db-id 43 --permission-type QUERY --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckBatchTableAccessPermission

parameters.help_en: The database ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html operation to obtain the physical database ID, or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html operation to obtain the logical database ID. > The value of DatabaseId is the same as the value of DbId
parameters.help_zh:
数据库ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html获取物理库ID的值，调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html获取逻辑库ID的值。
DatabaseId的值即为DbId的值
parameters.name: db_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:
true: Logical database.
false: Physical database
parameters.help_zh:
是否逻辑库，取值：
true：逻辑库
false：物理库
parameters.name: logic

parameters.help_en: The type of permission to be checked
parameters.name: permission_type

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. > You can obtain the tenant ID by moving the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the user has the permission. Valid values:
true: The user has the permission.
false: The user does not have the permission

Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
